headline: Dry, cool weather arrives Thursday; weekend and Monday rain chances remain uncertain.
summary: A weather system passing well offshore is weakening as it heads south. Behind it, a strong ridge of high pressure, a dome of high-altitude air, moves in Thursday and settles over the region Friday, bringing dry weather. Today starts gray and foggy, then turns sunny with highs near 50. Wednesday brings some clouds and showers, mostly to the south, plus breezy east winds in the foothills. Thursday and Friday stay dry, with cold mornings in the 30s and 20s, and forecasters are fairly confident in that. The weekend and Monday carry a chance of rain and mountain snow, but that part is uncertain because the models disagree on whether a stalled system moves inland or stays offshore.
